rules.overlap: Positive overlap of tuned-center intervals, or a single tuned center inside a prior interval. Two multi-point scans may share exactly one boundary. This is a work budget, not occupied RF bandwidth.
rules.empty_followup: Last measured candidate count zero forbids overlapping survey/inspection; adjacent exploration or stop. A violation rejects the proposal and stops cruise.
rules.candidate_rechecks: Fourth proposal overlapping three prior visits rejects even if grid, bandwidth, candidate ID or survey/inspection action changes. Full bounded history enforces visits beyond condensed last eight.
rules.termination: Third consecutive empty observation ends run; existing byte/step/time/operator limits remain. stop_session also permits goal completion or no useful permitted action. No claim that candidate absence proves empty spectrum.
rules.admission: Progress checked before ledger acceptance/ACK and again before sweep/inspection execution. Rejected v2 proposal persists and replay never executes.
rules.context: Optional cruise summary applies to automatic mode; current manual contexts omit it. Remaining steps, milliseconds, IQ bytes, constants and bounded recent visits validated by Rust and Node. Maximum 768-point/32-candidate context plus summary remains below 32KiB.
